Question B-001-010-008.

Why the correct answer is right: In the 902 MHz to 928 MHz band, amateur operations have reduced protection from interference by another service.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "144 MHz to 148 MHz": The 2-metre band has a 30 kHz bandwidth limit in B-001; the reduced-protection range is 902 MHz to 928 MHz.
- sourceIndex 2: "222 MHz to 225 MHz": The 222 MHz to 225 MHz range is a VHF amateur allocation, while the reduced-protection row for other-service interference applies to 902 MHz to 928 MHz.
- sourceIndex 3: "50 MHz to 54 MHz": The 6-metre band has a 30 kHz bandwidth limit in B-001; the reduced-protection range is 902 MHz to 928 MHz.
